Title: General Availability: Azure Cosmos DB Data Explorer keyboard shortcuts

Body.Content:
Maximize efficiency in Azure Cosmos DB Data Explorer with our new keyboard shortcuts. Navigate and manage your databases with increased speed, without the need for a mouse. This update brings a streamlined workflow, allowing you to execute tasks with simple key combinations. Whether executing a query or creating a new container, our intuitive shortcuts will save you time and enhance your productivity. The worry of losing progress by accidentally hitting F5 is now a thing of the past. Check out our doc to see the full list of what’s supported.   

Learn more.
